scope.description: Read-only review of prior InterSubMod strategies, sidecar/candidate-window experiments and performance records to separate comparable measurements from estimates and non-transferable scientific methods.

assumptions: Historical evidence is context, not LongLineage release evidence.
Only paths and metrics recoverable from source records may be reported.

step_verify.step: Recover exact prior paths, scopes, metrics and limitations for reusable acceleration strategies.
step_verify.verify: Handoff labels every number MEASURED, DERIVED, ESTIMATED or PLANNED and cites its source path.

step_verify.step: Separate reusable systems strategies from science-specific shortcuts.
step_verify.verify: Every reusable strategy includes a LongLineage semantic-parity condition; every unsafe transfer is explicitly rejected.

deviations: An initial broad recursive pattern search matched large payload JSON and was interrupted; every cited result was subsequently re-read from exact manifest, receipt or bounded document paths.
